newsitem.title: UK: Centrica seeks selective price cuts - paper.
newsitem.headline: Centrica seeks selective price cuts - paper.

text.p: Centrica, the former supply business of British Gas Plc, held talks with the industry regulator Ofgas earlier this week seeking to make the first selective price cuts for consumers, said The Independent on Friday.

Roy Gardner, Centrica's chief executive, is believed to have submitted a package of discounts to the regulator. These would effect 500,000 homes which are taking part in a trial of domestic competition in the south west of England.
But Ofgas will only allow Centrica to cut prices when it believes competition has already been firmly established.
The report said it believed Ofgas was sympathetic.
